title: One dashboard, two names
line: API Portal and API Console name the same dashboard. Both link to the same console, and no page uses both.

title: "Disabled" does too many jobs
line: Used for settings, accounts and buttons. On the firewall page it describes two toggles with opposite results.

title: Sonar outlived its retirement
line: Sonar support ended in September 2026, but the Audit API pages still say "Sonar API keys".

title: Two spellings of one menu path
line: "Organization Settings" and "Organization settings" both appear, and three pages use both.

title: Spaces are still here
line: Spaces became Projects, but the Comet data deletion article still says Spaces.
